input.summary: Move governing law to New York and replace mandatory arbitration with exclusive New York County court jurisdiction.
input.comment: [Playbook] We moved governing law to New York and replaced the mandatory arbitration forum with exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County (temporary injunctive relief aside), consistent with our accepted fora; Delaware, California or England and Wales with London courts would be an acceptable fallback.

ops.newText: the laws of the State of New York

ops.oldText: will be subject to and resolved by binding arbitration pursuant to the Arbitration Rules of U.S. Arbitration & Mediation, (www.usam.com). Any award or order rendered by the arbitrator may be confirmed as a judgment or order in any state or federal court of competent jurisdiction, which includes within the federal judicial district of the residence of the party against whom such award or order was entered.
ops.newText: will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the state and federal courts in New York County, New York, provided that either party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any other court of competent jurisdiction.
